text: Revised all cash offer of US$5.214 per share (equal to the previous terms without the special dividend component)
General meeting seeking approval for the proposed sale of the Tribal Group businesses to Main Capital Partners to be held on 2 October 2026
The Scheme is approved by the Court and General Meetings. The Scheme is expected to become effective during the first quarter of 2027
Union Jack had to date received irrevocable undertakings and letters of intent not to accept the offer in respect of approximately 23.50% of the shares
The Harworth Board is evaluating the revised offer with its advisers
